newsitem.title: USA: Eastern Environmental gets NYC license.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Environmental gets NYC license.

text.p: Eastern Environmental Services Inc said Monday that the New York City Trade Waste Commission granted it a temporary license to operate in New York City.
The license will remain in effect until Eastern's application, which was submitted to the commission in November 1996, is approved or denied, the company said.
The license is the first in a two step regulatory process of the Trade Waste Commission's consideration of Eastern's pending New York City acquisitions, the company said.
Eastern has previously announced a definitive agreement to acquire the assets of Waste Services Inc, a Brooklyn collection company with annual revenues of about $18 million.
Eastern has also signed definitive agreements to acquire the assets of Coney Island Rubbish Removal Inc, Golden Gate Carting Co and Red Ball Sanitation Service Corp.
The combined companies will have revenues of about $25 million on an annualized basis.
Eastern said the Trade Waste Commission was reviewing the acquisitions and the company expected prompt approval.
